name: aether-cluster-pane
description: Live pane beside the chat showing what is running on the aether bus: processes, held ports and dashboard reachability.

ports.title: Watched ports
ports.description: TCP ports to watch for listeners, comma or space separated (for example: 4222 7447).

dashboards.title: Dashboard URLs
dashboards.description: Dashboard URLs to ping for reachability, comma or space separated. Empty means none are pinged.

refreshSeconds.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: How often the pane refreshes, in seconds (minimum 1).

processMatch.title: Process match
processMatch.description: Substring that identifies an aether runtime process in its command line.
